 Transcript Hi, Vogue, I'm Jennifer Lawrence.
 Come get ready with me
 for The Hunger Games premiere.
 [uptempo music]
 I remember being on set on the first one
 and I was 21 and was like, Wow, one day,
 it'll be like 10 years from when we shot these movies.
 Granted, I think it's been a bit more than that.
 It's been like 15.
 But those movies have been one of the biggest parts
 of my entire life.
 My reaction was to call Josh
 and squeal on the phone with him
 because we were going to get to see each other.
 I'm not surprised that it was emotional.
 I mean, it was just so interesting.
 It was like, I imagine how people feel
 at like a 10-year high school reunion or something.
 It was like pretty much all the same crew.
 Some people were married and have babies.
 Some people had become grandparents.
 I obviously had had kids
 that I didn't have before when I was making the movies.
 And I'm fortunate that it's really only amazing memories,
 only a really, really positive experience in my life.
 I saw the movie, I watched it with Josh,
 and it's amazing.
 [camera clicks] [soft uptempo music]
 I didn't really get into clothes until my 30s.
 You don't know who yourself is.
 Like, be yourself.
 When you're young, you're like, Okay.
 It was based on what episode
 of whatever I was watching at the time.
 And now I have more of a sense of self, so.
 I didn't want to look overdone
 because the dress is very dramatic.
 Nina Park is really good at just doing natural makeup.
 She just kind of changes what you want about your face,
 but without piling a bunch of makeup on.
 [soft uptempo music]
 Jimmy always does my hair.
 And I really like tucking my hair into a coat
 when I'm not doing my hair and I'm not doing hair and makeup
 and I just have a wave and I tuck it under a coat.
 I like that because the dress is very done.
 So I think it was just coming from a place
 of trying to look undone.
 And I don't know if maybe it's some sort of mental rebellion
 because I just opened a hairline,
 so I know everybody's going to be looking at my hair,
 so I'm going to tuck it inside of a coat.
 [Jimmy] Well, let's see, I am-
 [Jennifer] He's using the mes.
 Yes, I'm using the mes. Deep root spray.
 We already did that when my hair was wet.
 Yeah, and then I use curling iron
 just to make a kind of a beachy wave.
 I haven't done a lot of red-carpet hair in my career,
 so this is a very unique relationship.
 I plucked him from editorial.
 I was doing my first photo shoot for mes
 and I knew I needed Jimmy
 because he's a legend.
 So I asked him and then we've been together ever since.
 No, it's not really collaborative.
 I just tell Jimmy, [laughs]
 but if it's going to be something that's ugly or bad,
 then he says no.
 So I guess in that sense, it's collaborative.
 I always say I'm a mama's boy.
 I want to make people happy.
 And so whatever Jen wants, I want to try to get there,
 but I can only do what I do.
 So then it becomes my hairstyle, I guess.
 The dress goes first and then shoes.
 I've been pregnant twice
 and my foot grew a whole size each time.
 [Jimmy] Wow. Never went back, so.
 [camera clicks] [light uptempo music]
 This is the dress that I'm going to wear
 to The Hunger Games premiere.
 It kind of looks like a hanging woman. [moans]
 My stylist, Ryan, and I have been holding onto this
 for a while because we knew that I wanted to wear it
 because it's spectacular,
 but where can you wear this if it's not a premiere?
 So when the premiere came up, it was...
 We had this on our files.
 But it's Dior.
 [Questioner] How long have you been working with Dior?
 Since I was like 22 or 23.
 I can't do the math.
 Over 10 years, 15 years.
 50 years.
 And the clothes are amazing.
 They're such a powerful neckline
 and you don't want to miss this belt.
 It's like a sash
 and you don't want to miss this flower.
 And it has sleeves.
 Not a lot of dresses have sleeves.
 It's like a coat.
 I'm going to wear my Longines watch.
 I'm going to decide
 between these two Fred Leighton earrings tonight.
 I'm leaning towards the black.
 I mean, I always love black.
 What if I go with a green now?
 It doesn't matter.
 They're both beautiful.
 [camera clicks] [light music]
 Let's go get the dress on. [laughs]
 Okay, Vogue, this is my final look.
 I'm off to the premiere.
 [soft uptempo music]
